data.exact_reserve_text: The profit on the technical account of GBP 68.7m (2013: profit GBP 79.7m) includes a run-off surplus of GBP 5.2m for prior accident years (2013: GBP 10.1m surplus). This included a surplus of GBP 13.4m for reinsurance acceptance business and a deficit of GBP 8.2m on direct business (2013: surplus of GBP 7.2m for reinsurance acceptance business and a surplus of GBP 2.9m on direct business).
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1414 reported a prior-accident-years run-off surplus of GBP 5.2m (favourable development), driven by a GBP 13.4m surplus on reinsurance acceptances partly offset by an GBP 8.2m deficit on direct business. The net effect was a modest release of reserves representing approximately 1.2% of opening gross claims outstanding. No specific prior-year catastrophe events are named in the reserve movement note.
raw_causal_phrases: run-off surplus of GBP 5.2m for prior accident years (2013: GBP 10.1m surplus)

surplus of GBP 13.4m for reinsurance acceptance business and a deficit of GBP 8.2m on direct business (2013: surplus of GBP 7.2m for reinsurance acceptance business and a surplus of GBP 2.9m on direct business)
There were no major catastrophe losses in 2014 or 2013, although there were a large number of significant attritional losses.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year run-off surplus (GBP 5.2m) taken from Note 7 (Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding). Note gives a breakdown by reinsurance acceptance and direct business but does not explicitly state 'gross' vs 'net' in that narrative; it is assumed to refer to gross run-off on prior years. No gross claims development triangle was present in the extracted pages to cross-check. No specific named prior-year catastrophe events were mentioned in the movement note.
